Cloud Desktop

Secure virtual desktops and managed devices so staff work safely from anywhere.

How we deliver it

Staff get a consistent desktop on any approved device while data stays in your tenant. Access is tied to identity, device health and conditional access rules.

  1. Profile users and applications to size the desktop pool
  2. Build images and publish apps from Azure or AWS
  3. Enrol devices and enforce policy with Intune
  4. Apply conditional access and monitor sessions

Outcomes

  • Fast onboarding and offboarding
  • Company data off personal devices
  • One policy across every endpoint
